title: IROP calls 56/57 — 1.6 billion CZK for new acute and forensic psychiatric beds
money_note: sum of the two published call allocations, 1,009,803,920 CZK (call 56, less developed regions) and 582,287,720 CZK (call 57, transition regions), per MS2021+ open data, converted at 24.340 CZK/EUR, the ČNB daily rate of 18 September 2026 (list #181, the latest fixing on 19 September, a Saturday); no EUR figure is published
summary: The Regional Development Ministry's IROP calls 56 and 57 hold about 1.6 billion CZK for hospitals, regions and other health providers building acute child and adult psychiatric beds and medium-security forensic wards. On 18 September 2026 the deadline moved from 13 November 2026 to 14 January 2027.
notes: Allocation: call 56 (06_22_056, MRR: Karlovarský, Ústecký, Liberecký, Královéhradecký, Pardubický, Olomoucký, Moravskoslezský, Zlínský kraj) 1,009,803,920 CZK = ERDF 858,333,332 + state budget max 151,470,588; call 57 (06_22_057, transition regions) 582,287,720 CZK in MS2021+ (the call text gives ERDF 407,601,404 + state budget max 174,868,316 = 582,469,720; the XML total is used). EU share of public funds by arithmetic: 85 % (56), 70 % (57); the applicant-level support rate sits in the Specifická pravidla, which this pass did not read. Project size: 10 M CZK minimum; maximum 150 M (activity A, child acute beds), 80 M (B, adult acute beds), 200 M (C, forensic wards with medium supervision) CZK for construction projects, 30 M CZK otherwise; one project per care site and activity. Eligible applicants: state organisational units, regions, municipalities and their organisations, NGOs and other health-service providers under Act 372/2011, with bed-count consents from the region and VZP and a Health Ministry opinion (call text). Window: continuous, open since 17 Oct 2023; the change note 'Přehled změn účinných k 18. 9. 2026' in both call texts moves the close from 13.11.2026 to 14.1.2027 to give time for more complex infrastructure projects (the 6 Aug 2026 texts had moved it from 15.9.2026 to 13.11.2026). Found by the MS2021+ weekly diff 2026-09-19 against the 2026-09-18 snapshot (DATUMUZAVRENI 2026-11-13 -> 2027-01-14 on both codes); it was on the 2026-09-18 pass's owed open-call backlog. Call texts: irop.gov.cz getmedia 56-...-MRR_18092026.pdf and 57-...-PR-18092026.pdf, captured in data/raw/2026-09-19/dotace/pages/.
